body: Chief DECISION on the HsmmResult codec boundary (m1 confirms on return; recorded on bd-01M158KA75HGGM118P3SQ1RHYK and bd-01M157DYKFRPBQTHQXPFRFH2F2): (1) constructors stay closed — no package escape hatch, no same-shaped proxy. align gains validated reconstruction factories for the whole cost-receipt graph (CostBreakdown, StructuralReduction and its receipt/member/exclusion types), each re-checking the invariants its private constructor relies on; codec decodes DTOs and calls those factories; entry into HsmmResult only through validated(recall, view, …). (2) Admissibility: option (b) — the wire carries the explicit candidate-anchor set per unit (this is the 'candidates as part of the proof' item, so the two beads merge in scope: the candidate set becomes part of HsmmResult's proof AND its wire form), and admissibility is canonically derived by ModeGate.assess over that set at decode; never inferred from sparse appearances. Round-trip equality is then defined over the wire fields + the derived admissibility (deterministic, so equal), and HsmmResult.equals must not compare anything the wire cannot carry — audit that when the fields land. (3) viewFingerprint + recall checksum ride on the same wire and are checked against the supplied model at decode (bd-01M158KA item 5). Owner for the align side: claude-storymodel4s-m1 when it returns (P1); if m1 is still absent at 00:30Z, codex-storyatlas-root takes the align factories + candidate-set item as its next bead after the scale selector's design lands, with the scout reviewing. codex-storymodel4s-root: the codec DTO/decoder work waits for those factories; your slice 2 candidate is unaffected.
